head: daeng
rule: Every surviving compound is the plain colour, sense 1, and the interesting result is negative: แดง's figurative senses take NOTHING from this list. Sense 2 (a hidden thing coming to light) and sense 3 (money) stay empty, and even คดีแดง, which looks figurative, is not — the dictionary says it is ตัดทอนจาก คดีหมายเลขแดง, a clipping of 'red case number', and Thai courts really do number a case in red on disposal. The colour reaches a long way on its own: a blush (หน้าแดง), a wedding invitation (ใบแดง), bloody flux (ลงแดง), a newborn (เด็กแดง), a yolk (ไข่แดง), a traffic light (ไฟแดง), a metal (ทองแดง), a lime paste, a mango, a tobacco, a lotus, a forest. That is one sense doing all the work, not eight senses sharing it.

1: กระเจี๊ยบแดง
